prompt_en: In a floodlit ceramic kiln studio overlooking a rain-glossed loading court, an adult woman pauses at a cooled kiln during the final quarter-turn of its small brass vent crank. Make a tactile analog fashion photograph, with calm human presence against heavy machinery and wet reflections. Her visible face and short dark bob with fine separated bangs follow the supplied portrait as appearance guidance. Her head faces the camera, with both eyes and the whole face clearly readable. She stands upright beside the closed kiln; her right hand wraps the waist-height crank handle, her right elbow stays below the chest, and her free left hand rests against her own thigh. In her champagne satin camisole, a central depression between the breasts is visible inside the adult subject's neckline; the neckline edges remain attached to a continuous constructed garment; the central skin contour stays distinguishable from fabric folds and cast shadows. The cowl hangs from the camisole's two shoulder straps: soft hanging folds descend between the neckline's visible attachment points; the folded edge belongs to the same continuous garment opening; fold depth and contact shadows keep the fabric separate from the underlying surface. Beneath an open olive jacket, a fitted inner garment and a separate loose outer garment remain individually readable; the outer layer stands away from the body while the inner follows its local contour; visible overlaps hems or lapels establish the two garments' layer order. The camisole fits at the waist and the jacket has broad sleeves and a boxy hem. Frame vertically from the complete head to the upper thighs at chest-height, slightly front three-quarter: the adult subject's visible face and selected garment feature occupy the same coherent frame; focus light and scale keep both the facial expression and garment feature readable; supporting hands hair and foreground leave those two declared regions distinguishable. A long dark skirt continues below the frame. Soft frontal daylight enters through the loading window; a warm work light glints on brass and satin amid deep olive shadows, fine film grain and natural skin texture.
